extracted.name: Crockpot Venison Veg Soup
extracted.description: Wanted some Vegetable Beef Soup. Had Deer in the freezer, instead.
ingredient_lines: 1 whole celery heart, leaves and all, plus one stalk. Chopped
1 lb Frozen Mixed Veg (P's & C's, corn, green and lima beans.)
1/2 tsp, each, ground sea salt and pepper
instruction_lines: Lay the 4 venison chops in the bottom of the crock-pot.
Add all the rest of the ingredients and stir, not disturbing the medallions.
Set on high crockpot setting. Let go for 8 hours, and then indefinitely on low.
Remove and shred the venison, add back.
